programme.title: Who's Minding The Store?

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: This dazzling film noir from Stanley Kubrick is about a struggling New York boxer (Jamie Smith), whose life is imperiled when he protects a nightclub dancer (Irene Kane) from her gangster boss.

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Winner of ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, this electrifying musical sets the ageless tragedy of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the slums of 1950s New York and stars Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, and George Chakiris.

programme.title: Fear Strikes Out
programme.desc: True story of the life of Jimmy Piersall, who battled mental illness to achieve stardom in major league baseball.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. But exactly one year later, the dead man returns from his watery grave, and he's looking for more than an apology.

programme.title: Carrie (2002)
programme.desc: Angela Bettis stars in this adaptation of Stephen King's classic tale of horror. Carrie White has been cursed with the power of telekinesis and when her tormenters commit an act of unforgivable humiliation, they'll soon learn a deadly lesson.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: When the Clark Family moves from Chicago to Cradle Bay, Steve is cautioned by Gavin Strick about the separating factions at the local high school, where the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic perfect students, rule.

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: To collect his aunt's inheritance, an unemployed man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must form a gospel choir and lead it to success.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's Project A2 (A Gai Waak Juk Jaap)
programme.desc: Dragon Mao is assigned to lead the local police force but soon discovers that police corruption is running wild right under his nose. When he's framed for a jewelry robbery, Dragon Mao must fight to clear his name.

programme.title: Wheels On Meals
programme.desc: Action-packed and full of fun, set off on a wacky adventure with kung-fu fighting cousins Thomas and David whose simple life running a fast-food van in Spain is turned upside down by the beautiful pickpocket Sylvia.

programme.title: Xia Ri Fu Xing aka Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars
programme.desc: The do-gooder Lucky Stars gang takes a well-deserved break in Thailand where they are told to contact an informant. Their vacation is cut short when the informant is murdered sending them back to Hong Kong to protect his girlfriend.

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Jack Black is more hilarious than ever as Ignacio, a monastery cook who feeds orphan children by day and by night transforms himself into Nacho Libre, a notorious Luchador in stretchy pants.

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: History was made...by these guys? Zed and Oh are cavemen who stumble into an epic journey of biblical proportions. One's a bumbling hunter, the other's a gentle gatherer; together, they become unlikely participants in history's most pivotal moments.

programme.title: Tropic Thunder
programme.desc: Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr. lead an ensemble cast in 'Tropic Thunder,' an action comedy about a group of self-absorbed actors who set out to make the most expensive war film.

programme.title: What Men Want
programme.desc: A successful sports agent (Taraji P. Henson) mysteriously gains the ability to hear men's thoughts. With this newfound power, she looks to outsmart her colleagues but the lengths she goes to put her relationships to the test in this hilarious comedy!

programme.title: Love, Weddings & Other Disasters
programme.desc: Diane Keaton, Jeremy Irons, and Maggie Grace lead this warmhearted romantic comedy that follows a colorful cast of characters searching for love against the backdrop of a wedding.

programme.title: Baby Boom
programme.desc: J.C. has inherited a baby girl. An adoption falls through and the child becomes very attached to J.C., who keeps the baby. The child's mischief leads to J.C. losing her job and her boyfriend, but lead her to invent an applesauce recipe for children.

programme.title: The Fan
programme.desc: When the San Francisco Giants pay centerfielder Bobby Rayburn (Wesley Snipes) $40 million to lead their team to the World Series, no one is happier or more supportive than #1 fan Gil Renard (Robert De Niro). Rating: R

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: A couple work hard to renovate their dream house and become landlords to pay for it. Unfortunately, one of their tenants has plans of his own.

programme.title: The Iron Claw
programme.desc: The true story of the Von Erich brothers (Zac Efron, Jeremy Allen White, and Harris Dickinson), who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage and Michael Peña star as two New York City Port Authority policemen who were trapped in the rubble of September 11, 2001.

programme.title: Radio
programme.desc: For anyone who has ever had a dream and everyone with the courage to stand up for what they believe, comes the real-life story of Robert 'Radio' Kennedy. Experience Radio's journey from a man no one understands to the coach no one could live without.

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: A detective opens up a fifteen-year-old missing persons case and begins to suspect that the boy it belongs to was murdered - and that a local rancher was involved.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Monster Trucks
programme.desc: When high school senior Tripp discovers a gas-guzzling creature named Creech, the unlikely duo team up for a fun-filled, hilarious and heartfelt adventure in a real-life super-powered Monster Truck to reunite Creech with his family.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When NY City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: John Wick (Keanu Reeves) uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: I Spy
programme.desc: Superstar Eddie Murphy (The Nutty Professor) teams up with Owen Wilson (Zoolander, Behind Enemy Lines) for a hilarious, action-packed thrill ride. Famke Janssen (X-Men, GoldenEye) also stars as an ultra-sexy secret agent. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: When a gang of bank robbers makes a run for the border, they wander into the wrong bar and mess with the wrong vampires. It's kill-or-be-killed in the ultimate battle to stop these evil creatures and save their own lives!

programme.title: Trust (2025)
programme.desc: A Hollywood star seeks refuge in an Airbnb after a scandal, only to find themselves at the mercy of seasoned criminals hunting a loot.

programme.title: Alma & the Wolf
programme.desc: After a violent animal attack, paranoia spreads through Spiral Creek. But when Deputy Ren Accord gets too close, his son vanishes, and reality begins to fracture.

programme.title: The Witch
programme.desc: In 1630 New England, panic and despair envelops a farmer, his wife and their children when youngest son Samuel suddenly vanishes.

programme.title: The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension
programme.desc: Buckaroo Banzai is a rock-star/brain-surgeon/comic-book-hero/samurai who along with his group, the Hong Kong Cavaliers, must stop evil creatures from the 8th dimension (all named John) who are trying to conquer our dimension.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, Wolfman, Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: D.A.R.Y.L.
programme.desc: A young boy is found wandering without any memory of who he is. A family takes him in and begin to look for clues to help him find his way home.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee
programme.desc: Michael J. Crocodile Dundee is a free-spirited Australian who hunts crocodiles with his bare hands, stares down giant water buffaloes, and drinks mere mortals under the table.

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: In Big Top Pee-Wee, I live on a country farm where I feed my barnyard animals pancake breakfasts and work on top-secret botanical experiments with my pet pig, Vance.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head Do America
programme.desc: When their TV is Stolen, Beavis and Butt-head hit the road in a hilarious film debut that proves what millions of fans already know: Beavis and Butt-head RULE!

programme.title: King of New York
programme.desc: Recently freed from prison, Frank White (Christopher Walken) begins to exterminate the drug lords who rose to power in his absence. When a group of enraged cops declares war on him, Frank's answer is to put a contract out on the cops.

programme.title: Kill The Irishman
programme.desc: Oscar®-winner Christopher Walken, Val Kilmer, and Ray Stevenson star in KILL THE IRISHMAN, the true story of a tough Irish thug working for mobsters in Cleveland during the 1970s.

programme.title: Mob Town
programme.desc: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: Ghost Town (2008)
programme.desc: A spirited romantic comedy, Ghost Town is the story of Bertram Pincus, a cranky Manhattan dentist who develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

programme.title: The Quick and the Dead
programme.desc: In this edgy and darkly humorous Western, a mysterious young woman rides into the lawless town of Redemption to settle an old score that has haunted her since she was a child. She becomes swept up in a deadly quick-draw tournament. Rated: R

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: The Fan
programme.desc: When the San Francisco Giants pay centerfielder Bobby Rayburn (Wesley Snipes) $40 million to lead their team to the World Series, no one is happier or more supportive than #1 fan Gil Renard (Robert De Niro). Rating: R

programme.title: Johnny Mnemonic
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves is a space-age courier who's plugged in, turned on and buffed up to deliver the most important data of the 21st century, wet-wired directly into his brain! A rapid-fire roller coaster of action and high-impact imagery! Rating: R

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: In one of his most memorable roles, Burt Reynolds portrays a moonshine whiskey runner who turns state's witness to avenge the murder of a boy no one understood.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty
programme.desc: In a society in which major league sporting events have replaced Sunday worship as the religion of choice, North Dallas Forty appears like a desecration at the altar.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future for all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life or death struggle in order to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

programme.title: Sydney White
programme.desc: A modern retelling of Snow White set against students in their freshman year of college in the greek system.

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: Comic icon Steve Martin steps into the shoes of the late Peter Sellers and wonderfully reprises the role of the bumbling, world famous Inspector Jacques Clouseau in this remake of Blake Edwards comedy classic, The Pink Panther.

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: Inspector Jacques Clouseau teams up with a squad of international detectives just as bumbling as he is. Their mission: Stop a globe-trotting thief who specializes in stealing historical artifacts.

programme.title: Queenpins
programme.desc: A housewife and her friend hatch an illegal coupon-club scheme that scams millions from corporations and delivers deals to the public. Hot on their trail is an unlikely duo -- a hapless loss-prevention officer and a determined U.S. postal inspector.

programme.title: Knives Out
programme.desc: The circumstances surrounding the death of crime novelist Harlan Thrombey are mysterious, but there's one thing that renowned Detective Benoit Blanc knows for sure -- everyone in the wildly dysfunctional Thrombey family is a suspect.

programme.title: Confidence
programme.desc: A con man (Edward Burns) and his crew swindle a gangster's accountant, then try to repay him by stealing from a crooked banker.

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Trading Places

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Winner of ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, this electrifying musical sets the ageless tragedy of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the slums of 1950s New York and stars Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, and George Chakiris.

programme.title: Fear Strikes Out
programme.desc: True story of the life of Jimmy Piersall, who battled mental illness to achieve stardom in major league baseball.

programme.title: The Pride of the Yankees
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of famed baseball player Lou Gehrig.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: Killer Elite
programme.desc: A special-ops agent must rescue his mentor.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: When the Clark Family moves from Chicago to Cradle Bay, Steve is cautioned by Gavin Strick about the separating factions at the local high school, where the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic perfect students, rule.

programme.title: The Reading
programme.desc: After a deadly home invasion, Emma (Mo'Nique Hicks) copes by writing a book, but when a young psychic and her team perform a reading in her home, a new terror is unleashed.

programme.title: The Babadook
programme.desc: In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Whitney
programme.desc: An intimate, unflinching portrait of Whitney Houston and her family that probes beyond familiar tabloid headlines and sheds new light on the spellbinding trajectory of Houston's life.

programme.title: Xia Ri Fu Xing aka Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars
programme.desc: The do-gooder Lucky Stars gang takes a well-deserved break in Thailand where they are told to contact an informant. Their vacation is cut short when the informant is murdered sending them back to Hong Kong to protect his girlfriend.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's Project A
programme.desc: Dragon Ma a lieutenant in the 19th-century Hong Kong marines battles Pirates that have been terrorizing local waters in this must-see adrenaline-pumping adventure delivers all the intense thrills and witty fun that Jackie Chan fans demand!

programme.title: Jackie Chan's Project A2 (A Gai Waak Juk Jaap)
programme.desc: Dragon Mao is assigned to lead the local police force but soon discovers that police corruption is running wild right under his nose. When he's framed for a jewelry robbery, Dragon Mao must fight to clear his name.

programme.title: Tropic Thunder
programme.desc: Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr. lead an ensemble cast in 'Tropic Thunder,' an action comedy about a group of self-absorbed actors who set out to make the most expensive war film.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun is content to be a bright but unfocused surf slacker until the day he discovers a novel by acclaimed author Martin Skinner. Inspired, he suddenly leaves Orange County to study creative writing at Stanford University.

programme.title: Baby Boom
programme.desc: J.C. has inherited a baby girl. An adoption falls through and the child becomes very attached to J.C., who keeps the baby. The child's mischief leads to J.C. losing her job and her boyfriend, but lead her to invent an applesauce recipe for children.

programme.title: Soapdish
programme.desc: Sally Field leads an all-star cast in this side-splittingly funny look at a scandal-ridden TV soap opera.

programme.title: Untamed Heart
programme.desc: Two of today's hottest young actors, Christian Slater and Marisa Tomei, star in this tender romance about lonely souls destined to find one another. Co-starring Rosie Perez.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: A couple work hard to renovate their dream house and become landlords to pay for it. Unfortunately, one of their tenants has plans of his own.

programme.title: Single White Female
programme.desc: SWF seeks female to share apt in West 70s. Non-smoker, professional preferred. An innocent want ad opens the door to murderous, unrelenting terror in this pulse-pounding psychological shocker starring Bridget Fonda and Jennifer Jason Leigh. Rated: R

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage and Michael Peña star as two New York City Port Authority policemen who were trapped in the rubble of September 11, 2001.

programme.title: Radio
programme.desc: For anyone who has ever had a dream and everyone with the courage to stand up for what they believe, comes the real-life story of Robert 'Radio' Kennedy. Experience Radio's journey from a man no one understands to the coach no one could live without.

programme.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
programme.desc: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: A detective opens up a fifteen-year-old missing persons case and begins to suspect that the boy it belongs to was murdered - and that a local rancher was involved.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When NY City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: I Spy
programme.desc: Superstar Eddie Murphy (The Nutty Professor) teams up with Owen Wilson (Zoolander, Behind Enemy Lines) for a hilarious, action-packed thrill ride. Famke Janssen (X-Men, GoldenEye) also stars as an ultra-sexy secret agent. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Fools Rush In
programme.desc: Matthew Perry stars as Alex Whitman, a New Yorker sent to Las Vegas to oversee a construction project. There he meets Isabel Fuentes, and some serious chemistry brings them together for one night. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Cameron instantly falls for the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: When a gang of bank robbers makes a run for the border, they wander into the wrong bar and mess with the wrong vampires. It's kill-or-be-killed in the ultimate battle to stop these evil creatures and save their own lives!

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Set in Mexico in the early 1900s, this prequel to the From Dusk Till Dawn series finds outlaw Johnny Madrid on the run from the hangman, with the hangman's daughter Esmeralda by his side. Together they are faced with the fight of their lives.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: Labor Day
programme.desc: From Academy Award-nominated director Jason Reitman (Up in the Air, Juno), starring Kate Winslet and Josh Brolin as two strangers drawn together under incredible circumstances.

programme.desc: Nicolas Cage and Michael Peña star as two New York City Port Authority policemen who were trapped in the rubble of September 11, 2001.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction

programme.title: Billy Madison
programme.desc: 27-year-old Billy Madison must repeat all 12 grades of school to earn his father's respect and prove he has what it takes to run the family business.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: There's Something About Mary
programme.desc: A man reunites with his dream girl, even though their past was a disaster.

programme.title: Tank Girl

programme.title: Major League

programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: In Big Top Pee-Wee, I live on a country farm where I feed my barnyard animals pancake breakfasts and work on top-secret botanical experiments with my pet pig, Vance.

programme.desc: 1930's New York. The black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. If the seeds of Harlem's urban power would not grow in the White city, the Black underground would form to take control.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: End Of Watch
programme.desc: Officers Brian Taylor (Jake Gyllenhaal) and Mike Zavala (Michael Peña) form a powerful brotherhood to ensure they both go home at the end of their shifts in South Central, Los Angeles.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dollars
programme.desc: The Man With No Name (Clint Eastwood) receives offers from two gangs terrorizing a small town and accepts both, setting in motion a plan to destroy the criminals in a series of brilliantly orchestrated setups, showdowns, and deadly confrontations.

programme.title: For A Few Dollars More
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood returns as the Man With No Name, who teams up with equally lethal Colonel Mortimer (Lee Van Cleef) in pursuit of a sadistic killer and his band of desperadoes in this non-stop action classic from legendary director Sergio Leone.

programme.title: The Quick and the Dead
programme.desc: In this edgy and darkly humorous Western, a mysterious young woman rides into the lawless town of Redemption to settle an old score that has haunted her since she was a child. She becomes swept up in a deadly quick-draw tournament. Rated: R

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman (Rainman) plays the likable graduate student and marathon runner of the title, unwillingly trapped in a killing game of intrigue involving a Nazi fugitive, Christian Szell.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future for all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.desc: The circumstances surrounding the death of crime novelist Harlan Thrombey are mysterious, but there's one thing that renowned Detective Benoit Blanc knows for sure -- everyone in the wildly dysfunctional Thrombey family is a suspect.

programme.title: Confidence
programme.desc: A con man (Edward Burns) and his crew swindle a gangster's accountant, then try to repay him by stealing from a crooked banker.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: The survivor of a space expedition claims his crew was killed by an alien creature. The rescue captain dismisses the explanation only to find that a creature has stowed away on the spacecraft and begins to hunt the human hosts.

programme.title: Invaders From Mars
programme.desc: In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

programme.title: John Wick
programme.desc: When sadistic thugs attack John Wick (Keanu Reeves) – a brilliantly lethal ex-assassin - he hunts them down with the skill and ruthlessness that made him an underworld legend.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
programme.desc: John Wick is forced out of retirement, and this time, he must face off against a shadowy international assassins' guild and more of the world's deadliest killers.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
programme.desc: John Wick is on the run after killing a member of the international assassins' guild, and with a $14 million price tag on his head, he is the target of hit men and women everywhere.

programme.title: The Final Girls
programme.desc: A young woman grieving the loss of her mother, a famous scream queen from the 1980s, finds herself pulled into the world of her mom's most famous movie. Reunited, the women must fight off the film's maniacal killer.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Bob Marley: One Love
programme.desc: Celebrate the life of an icon who inspired generations through his message of love, peace, and unity. In 'One Love,' discover Bob Marley's powerful story of overcoming adversity and the journey behind his revolutionary music that changed the world.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: From the Oscar-winning producers of 12 Years a Slave comes a powerful true story starring David Oyelewo and Oprah Winfrey. Facing violent opposition, Martin Luther King, Jr., led a historic march from Selma to Montgomery, changing the world forever.

programme.title: Operation Condor II: The Armour Of The Gods
programme.desc: Jackie Chan is a fortune hunter whose ex-girlfriend is kidnapped by an evil cult! Things kick into high gear when her fiancée, an old friend of Jackie’s, asks him for help in securing the kidnappers’ lone demand: the priceless Armor of The Gods!

programme.title: The Prisoner
programme.desc: Jackie Chan plays a shrewd cop who goes undercover with a team of mercenaries when a man he put away two years before commits a murder. The film features the great Sammo Hung as well as the terrific Tony Leung Ka Fai.

programme.title: Supercop (1996)
programme.desc: Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, and Maggie Cheung lead an action-packed classic with jaw-dropping stunts, from leaping out a ten-story building onto an airborne helicopter to landing on top of a speeding train.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura Pet Detective is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback Dan Marino. He goes eye to eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: The Big Lebowski
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Steve Buscemi and Julianne Moore star in this Coen brothers’ cult comedy about the Dude, his buddies, a case of mistaken identity, kidnapping and bowling.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Joy Ride
programme.desc: When a psychotic trucker takes offense at the pranks pulled by a couple of college students, the young kids are sucked into a whirlpool of terror.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
programme.desc: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

programme.title: Labor Day
programme.desc: From Academy Award-nominated director Jason Reitman (Up in the Air, Juno), starring Kate Winslet and Josh Brolin as two strangers drawn together under incredible circumstances.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: American Outlaws
programme.desc: When a Midwest town learns that a corrupt railroad baron has captured the deeds to their homesteads without their knowledge, young ranchers join forces to take back what is rightfully theirs.

programme.title: The Quick And The Dead
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger rides into a homesteading family's life when they are attacked by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: There's Something About Mary
programme.desc: A man reunites with his dream girl, even though their past was a disaster.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: This Is the End
programme.desc: THIS IS THE END follows six friends trapped in a house after a series of strange and catastrophic events devastate Los Angeles. As the world unravels outside, dwindling supplies and cabin fever threaten to tear apart the friendships inside.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: When a gang of bank robbers makes a run for the border, they wander into the wrong bar and mess with the wrong vampires. It's kill-or-be-killed in the ultimate battle to stop these evil creatures and save their own lives!

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Set in Mexico in the early 1900s, this prequel to the From Dusk Till Dawn series finds outlaw Johnny Madrid on the run from the hangman, with the hangman's daughter Esmeralda by his side. Together they are faced with the fight of their lives.

programme.title: Trust (2025)
programme.desc: A Hollywood star seeks refuge in an Airbnb after a scandal, only to find themselves at the mercy of seasoned criminals hunting a loot.

programme.title: 3 From Hell
programme.desc: First there was HOUSE OF 1000 CORPSES. Then there was THE DEVIL'S REJECTS. Now, from writer-director Rob Zombie, comes the next blood-soaked chapter in the most violent crime saga in movie history.

programme.title: Eden Lake
programme.desc: A young couple travels to a remote lake quarry in England, only to fend off a group of teenage hoods.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless they deliver immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies together and starts to win.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries getting accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee
programme.desc: Michael J. Crocodile Dundee is a free-spirited Australian who hunts crocodiles with his bare hands, stares down giant water buffaloes, and drinks mere mortals under the table.

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: In Big Top Pee-Wee, I live on a country farm where I feed my barnyard animals pancake breakfasts and work on top-secret botanical experiments with my pet pig, Vance.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head Do America
programme.desc: When their TV is Stolen, Beavis and Butt-head hit the road in a hilarious film debut that proves what millions of fans already know: Beavis and Butt-head RULE!

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: End Of Watch
programme.desc: Officers Brian Taylor (Jake Gyllenhaal) and Mike Zavala (Michael Peña) form a powerful brotherhood to ensure they both go home at the end of their shifts in South Central, Los Angeles.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: A crew of officers at an armored transport security firm embark on the ultimate heist – against their own company. The seemingly fool-proof plan soon proves to be useless when an unexpected witness interferes, as the plan quickly unravels.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: Parker is a thief who lives by a personal code of ethics: Don't steal from people who can't afford it and don't hurt people who don't deserve it. But on his latest heist, his crew double-crosses him, steals his stash, and leaves him for dead.

programme.title: For A Few Dollars More
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood returns as the Man With No Name, who teams up with equally lethal Colonel Mortimer (Lee Van Cleef) in pursuit of a sadistic killer and his band of desperadoes in this non-stop action classic from legendary director Sergio Leone.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Ugly
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood portrays the invincible 'Man With No Name' in lethal pursuit of $200,000 in Confederate money alongside Lee Van Cleef and Eli Wallach in this renowned, influential, and classic cinematic western directed by the great Sergio Leone.

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell star in director Harold Ramis' brilliant comedy about a man who clones himself to save his marriage, and then almost loses his wife to himself! Keaton takes on four hilariously distinct roles.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: One look, and you know they're from a very strange place. They're from New Jersey, by way of France, by way of far-off, far-out Remulak. They're Coneheads.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman (Rainman) plays the likable graduate student and marathon runner of the title, unwillingly trapped in a killing game of intrigue involving a Nazi fugitive, Christian Szell.

programme.title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
programme.desc: As a small time hood Eddie is about to go back to jail. In order to escape this fate he deals information on stolen guns to the feds. Simultaneously he is supplying arms to his bank robbing/kidnapping hoodlum chums.

programme.title: Serpico
programme.desc: A true-life drama of a cop whose revelations about the extent of bribery in the New York Police Department almost led to his death and resulted in the creation of the Knapp Commission.

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: An extraterrestrial race forced to live in slum-like conditions on Earth suddenly find a kindred spirit in a government agent that is exposed to their biotechnology.

programme.title: The Astronaut's Wife
programme.desc: Astronaut Spencer Armacost and his beautiful schoolteacher wife are so passionately in love that they can sense each other even while he floats in space and she is 200,000 miles below. But in two minutes, it all turns to terror.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnam soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (2005)
programme.desc: The story of a pro quarterback and former college champion and coach are asked to put together a football team of inmates to take on the guards while doing their time in prison.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: A conflict between black and Jewish gangsters in New York City and a case of mistaken identity land a man (Josh Hartnett) in the middle of a revenge plot of a crime boss (Morgan Freeman).

programme.title: The Con Is On
programme.desc: In an effort to avoid paying off a massive gambling debt to a notorious mobster in England, two badly behaved con artists flee to Los Angeles, where they hatch a convoluted plot to steal jewels.

programme.title: The Brothers Bloom
programme.desc: A swindler falls in love with the eccentric heiress he and his brother have chosen as their final mark before quitting con games.

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor, Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Menace II Society
programme.desc: In an unflinching look at the mean streets of the contemporary urban American ghetto, a Black youth—despite his dreams for a better life—ultimately succumbs to the cycle of violence that pervades his community.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: It’s the 23rd century and an alien power is evaporating the oceans. To save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time travel back to 1986 where they find a world of punk, pizza and exact-change buses that are as alien as anything they’ve ever encountered.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Captain Kirk and his crew must deal with Mr. Spock's long-lost half-brother, who hijacks the Enterprise for an obsessive search for God at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when a Klingon ship is nearly destroyed by an apparent attack from the Enterprise. Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

programme.title: Sydney White
programme.desc: A modern retelling of Snow White set against students in their freshman year of college in the greek system.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: When Beca joins the all-girl a capella singing group The Bellas, she pushes them to change up their repertoire as they climb their way to the top.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: When Shelley gets kicked out of the mansion, she's lost in the wilds of Beverly Hills until she stumbles upon the sorriest sorority on campus. Now it's up to her to spruce up the girls and heat up the Zeta house before the University shuts them down.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Friday After Next
programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.

programme.title: House Party

programme.title: El Pequeño Gangster

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Avril Lavigne: Live in England 2024
programme.desc: La legendaria Avril Lavigne, icono del pop-punk, saltó a la fama con himnos de la rebeldía como "Complicated", que definieron a una generación con su estilo atrevido y emotivo.

programme.title: Top of the Pops: The Collection
programme.desc: Las presentaciones más icónicas de la escena de Madchester.

programme.title: Alabama Shakes - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: El grupo estadounidense Alabama Shakes sube al escenario de Austin City Limits por segunda vez, con una mezcla de R&B y rock.

programme.title: My Chemical Romance - Live from Tokyo
programme.desc: Desde el Yokohama Arena de Tokio, el concierto en vivo de My Chemical Romance. La banda presenta cinco de sus mayores éxitos del álbum de 2010.

programme.title: U2 Rattle and Hum
programme.desc: El cineasta Phil Joanou muestra a la banda de rock británica de gira, en Harlem, en la mansión de Elvis Presley en concierto, mayormente en blanco y negro.

programme.title: Un Monje a Pruebas de Balas
programme.desc: Un monje tibetano inmortal se convierte en el mentor de un joven chico a quien enseña a proteger un viejo pergamino que el monje ha cuidado durante sesenta años. Con la ayuda de una escurridiza joven, ambos combatirán contra un malvado maestro de kung fu.

programme.title: El aprendiz
programme.desc: Un ex-agente de la CIA vuelve a la acción para proteger a un testigo muy valioso, pero pronto se da cuenta de que los tiempos han cambiado y ya no puede confiar en nadie, ni siquiera en aquellos a los que consideraba sus amigos.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un tranquilo vagabundo es engañado para que acepte un trabajo de conserje en el ahora condenado Willy's Wonderland.

programme.title: Caliente
programme.desc: Cinco obreros de la construcción en mala racha forman un espectáculo de striptease masculino.

programme.title: Caliente 2
programme.desc: Cuando dos amigos deciden abrir su propio club de striptease en Miami, nada sale como lo habían planeado.

programme.title: Caliente 3
programme.desc: Para salir de sus problemas económicos, cinco amigos no tienen otra opción que volver al escenario y retomar el striptease.

programme.title: Niños de la Noche
programme.desc: Un adolescente privilegiado es enviado a un internado donde se hace amigo de un compañero algo excéntrico. Juntos escapan en secreto y descubren un club nocturno oculto en el bosque, donde salen a la luz los oscuros y retorcidos secretos de la escuela.

programme.title: Amor a mordidas
programme.desc: La escuela está cerrada y las fiestas han comenzado en Rainmouth. Obligado a trabajar en su bote y escuchar acerca de sus cuatro amigas calientes, Jamie estó desesperado por escapar. Eso es hasta que conoce a Juliana una viajera misteriosa de América.

programme.title: Pumpkinhead
programme.desc: Después de un trágico accidente, un hombre (Lance Henriksen) evoca a un imponente y vengativo demonio llamado Pumpkinhead para destruir a un grupo de adolescentes desprevenidos en este aterrador clásico de terror.

programme.title: Very Good Girls
programme.desc: Dos chicas de la ciudad de Nueva York hacen un pacto para perder su virginidad durante su primer verano fuera de la escuela secundaria. Cuando ambas se enamoran del mismo artista callejero, su amistad se pondrá a prueba por primera vez.

programme.title: No Dispare
programme.desc: A los 9 años, David perdió a sus padres y a su hermana en una masacre en una tienda y ahora tiene que vivir con sus abuelos. Su abuelo tiene la tarea casi imposible de dar a David una nueva perspectiva de la vida, del futuro.

programme.title: Obsesión
programme.desc: Simon hereda una casa de campo a la que viaja con su familia. Su sueño es renovarla, pero cae en un romance prohibido. Ahora tendrá que estar dispuesta a llegar hasta las últimas consecuencias para recuperar su tranquilidad y a su familia.

programme.title: El Redentor
programme.desc: Un ex soldado de las fuerzas especiales con mala reputación navega por el inframundo criminal de Londres y aprovecha la oportunidad para asumir la identidad de otro hombre convertirse en el ángel de la muerte.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: Bajo Amenaza
programme.desc: Jeff Talley, un ex negociador de rehenes, intenta rescatar a una familia secuestrada en su nueva ciudad. Sin embargo, el padre de la familia guarda secretos peligrosos y delincuentes inestables complican su misión.

programme.title: La Sirenita
programme.desc: El periodista Cam Harrison va a investigar la historia de una sirena. Lleva a su sobrina a esta empresa y los dos son testigos de su actuación en un circo. Cam está enamorado de la sirena y la protege cuando el dueño del circo se enfurece por su fuga.

programme.title: El Niño de Oro
programme.desc: Mats es un chico corriente como cualquier otro. Pero cuando encuentras pantalones que contienen una cantidad ilimitada de dinero, ¡todo cambia! De repente, el mundo está a sus pies y puede cumplir todos sus sueños.

programme.title: La leyenda del gigante de la montaña
programme.desc: En esta aventura de la mitología nórdica, Espen, el hijo de un humilde granjero, se embarca en una peligrosa aventura con sus hermanos para salvar a la princesa de la región de un malvado monstruo conocido como "el gigante de la montaña".

programme.title: ¿Cómo diablos le hace?
programme.desc: Una comedia centrada en la vida de Kate Reddy, una ejecutiva financiera que es el sostén de su esposo y sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Una cenicienta de moda
programme.desc: El sueño de Kate es diseñar para las casas de alta costura. A pesar de que es una joven con un brillante talento, Kate no puede conseguir un trabajo. Y es que nadie confía en lahijade Lee Kassell, un minorista que comercializa diseños de baja calidad.

programme.title: El Amor Más Allá del Tiempo
programme.desc: En un futuro cercano, un político recién salido de una derrota electoral se escapa a la casa de verano de su familia en el lago. Sus vacaciones se ven interrumpidas por la aparición de su primer amor, que acaba de regresar de un viaje espacial.

programme.title: El Misterio de Ozarks
programme.desc: En 1866, un joven médico es convocado por su tío a un pueblo remoto en los Ozarks solo para descubrir a su llegada que el paraíso utópico no es todo lo que parece ser.

programme.title: En el Rastro del Enemigo

programme.desc: Naruto y sus compañeros investigan el paradero de la estrella robada. El grupo sospecha que el culpable es un habitante de la Aldea de la Estrella, ya que el ninja que la robó usó una técnica, Kujaku, que pertenece a la aldea.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Jutsu Escondido! El Precio Del Arte Ninja: Kujaku
programme.desc: Akahoshi, el ninja enmascarado que secuestró a Sumaru, pretende usar a Sumaru para descubrir quién es el misterioso ninja que robó la estrella.

programme.title: Naruto: Hoshikage: La verdad oculta
programme.desc: El ninja enmascarado y Naruto caen hacia las profundidades del valle. Mientras cura las heridas de Naruto, el ninja enmascarado le cuenta por qué ha robado la estrella.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Queda poco tiempo!

programme.title: Naruto: La brillante luz de la estrella
programme.desc: Sumaru siente la muerte de su madre y enfurece. Naruto es incapaz de evitar que se marche corriendo. Con el objetivo de salvar a Sumaru, Hokuto y Mizura arriesgan sus vidas para revelar la verdad acerca del entrenamiento estrella.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Kiba tiene un día de perros!

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Mientras están viendo un programa de investigación de delitos, Kenan y Kel se convencen de que el padre de Kenan es un ladrón conocido como el “Bandido Diamante”, e intentan devolver lo que ellos creen que son los diamantes robados.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel tiene un resfriado, y Kenan decide preparar un remedio casero, usando pollo, huevos, sardinas, malvaviscos y gaseosa de naranja. Para su sorpresa, Kel se cura y ahora Kenan tiene que acordarse de la receta, cuando su papá se enferma.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan salva la vida del presidente de los Estados Unidos y es invitado a la Casa Blanca, en donde Kel, accidentalmente, destruye una fotografía muy valiosa.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan ha ahorrado suficiente dinero para comprar una nueva bicicleta justo a tiempo para Navidad, pero ¿gastará ese dinero solo para él? ¿O habrá un espacio en su corazón para el espíritu navideño?

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan entra en pánico cuando la directora de la escuela pide una reunión con él y sus padres. Pensando que hizo algo malo, decide contratar a dos actores para que hagan de sus padres durante la cita.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Es el Día de Acción de Gracias y el padre de Kenan ha preparado un pavo. Pero cuando nadie está en la cocina, Kel no puede resistir la tentación y se devora el pavo en cuestión de minutos. Ahora Kenan y Kel están en grandes problemas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una maestra sustituta en la clase y Kel está seguro de que ella está enamorada de Kenan. Kenan no le cree al principio, pero Kel es persistente y persuasivo. Comienza a convencer a Kenan de que puede tener razón.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.desc: Tras un breve recorrido por la maravillosa ciudad de agua, Luffy, Nami y Usopp llegan al astillero, donde los artesanos acaban de derrotar a unos piratas que no querían pagar la reparación de su barco. Mientras tanto, Robin y Chopper salen de compras.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: La familia Franky e Iceberg-san
programme.desc: Luego de cambiar el oro por dinero en efectivo, Luffy, Nami y Usopp van al astillero para ver a Iceberg-san y que presupuesten el arreglo del barco. Mientras tanto, unos ladrones atacan al Going Merry, donde solo se encuentra Zoro.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡Galley-La Company! Un gran espectáculo en el Muelle 1
programme.desc: Mientras Kaku revisa el Going Merry, Luffy, Nami y Usopp conocen al resto de los capataces de Galley-La. Los matones de la familia Franky aprovechan un descuido de Usopp y vuelven a robarle el dinero.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: El incidente del secuestro del pirata y el barco que solo puede esperar su final
programme.desc: Mientras Luffy y Nami reciben la impactante noticia de que el Merry no tiene arreglo, Usopp queda muy malherido tras la paliza que le dan los matones de la familia Franky, pero aun así intenta ir a recuperar el dinero.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡El rescate de nuestro amigo! Asalto a la Franky House
programme.desc: Luffy, Zoro, Sanji y Chopper se dirigen a la Franky House para vengar a Usopp y recuperar el dinero. Mientras tanto, Nami se queda en el barco esperando el regreso de Robin, que sigue desaparecida.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡Gran lucha bajo la luna! ¡La bandera pirata ondea con tristeza!
programme.desc: Tras rescatar y tratar las heridas de Usopp, Luffy comunica a los demás su decisión sobre el futuro del barco. Usopp no está de acuerdo con Luffy, por lo que tras una gran discusión, decide abandonar el barco.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡Luffy contra Usopp! La colisión del orgullo de dos hombres
programme.desc: Tras la fuerte discusión, Usopp desafía a un duelo a Luffy. Luego de unas horas, Usopp acude a la cita totalmente preparado para la pelea con Luffy, quien por respeto a su amigo decide no contenerse.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡La ciudad del agua recibe un serio golpe! ¡Atacan a Iceberg!
programme.desc: Mientras los Sombrero de Paja están de mal ánimo por lo ocurrido con Usopp, ocurre un grave incidente en la ciudad: Alguien dispara a Iceberg.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: El humano de goma contra el cíborg que exhala fuego
programme.desc: Con el objetivo de vengar a sus compañeros, Luffy y Franky empiezan a pelearse en el Muelle 1 pero la pelea es súbitamente interrumpida por los trabajadores de Galley-La, quienes quieren atrapar a Luffy porque piensan que está involucrado en el atentado.

programme.title: iCarly

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly recibe una propuesta para ser becada completamente en la famosa y exclusiva escuela privada Briarwood. Carly muestra algunas dudas, pero Sam y Freddie saben que tienen que hacerla cambiar de opinión

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Freddie necesita pasar menos tiempo con las chicas, por eso decide acompañar a Spencer a sus clases de esgrima. Freddie resulta ser un esgrimista nato, por lo que Spencer lo hace pelear contra el increíble Doug Toder

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam y Freddie quieren ayudar a Gibby ya que no se anima a invitar a salir a la chica que le gusta. Por eso los chicos deciden armar un segmento en el show, llamado gane una cita, para que ellos concreten un encuentro

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly en Japón Parte 1
programme.desc: A Carly, Sam y Freddie les han enviado un correo electrónico y les dice que han sido nominados para el Premio Internacional de Internet llamado iWeb, con sede en Japón.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly en Japón - Parte 2
programme.desc: Luego de un viaje extremadamente peligroso, llegan a su hotel en Tokio. Kyoko y Yuki, su competencia, hacen caer en una trampa a Spencer y la Señora Benson, y dejan a Carly, Sam y Freddie en el medio de la nada.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly en Japón - Parte 3
programme.desc: Spencer y la Señora Benson deben salvar a los chicos antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Tras hallarlos en la carretera, logran llegar antes de que empiece la competencia, pero como no tienen identificaciones y les prohíben la entrada.

programme.title: iCarly: Yo lo ví primero
programme.desc: Cuando Sam y Carly muestran interés por el mismo chico amigo de Freddie, ellas prometen que no interferirá entre su amistad. Resulta ser más complicado de lo que imaginaban, y pronto su amistad se pone a prueba.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Ryuk el Shinigami, que dejó caer el Death Note en el mundo humano advierte a Light que alguien le sigue la pista. Light está preocupado por no poder descubrir la identidad de su perseguidor, pero Ryuk le propone un trato sorprendente...

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light, conocido mundialmente como Kira, prueba el alcance de los poderes del Death Note matando a 6 convictos de diferentes maneras, así confirma que puede controlar las acciones de sus víctimas ¡antes de que mueran!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Soichiro Yagami demanda una reunión en persona con L cuando se entera que él secretamente ha traído agentes del FBI a Japón, mientras tanto, Light ha encontrado una manera de sacar a los agentes del FBI ¡permanentemente del caso!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light se reúne con una mujer en el departamento de policía ya que tiene un mensaje importante para el cuerpo especial Kira, como hijo del investigador en jefe, Light escucha su historia y descubre que ella posee información que podría llevar a su arresto!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light usa el Death Note para tratar de deshacerse de la mujer que podría capturarlo, y se sorprende cuando no funciona. Ella le ha dado un nombre falso. Light solo tiene minutos para averiguar su nombre antes de contar su historia a la policía.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: L insiste en plantar micrófonos y cámaras en los hogares de los miembros del cuerpo especial incluyendo la casa de Yagami, pero como siempre, Light está un paso adelante, sabe que está siendo observado!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Los asesinatos continúan y L empieza a sospechar del comportamiento perfecto de Light así que decide investigarlo por su cuenta, para poder alcanzar su meta, L se inscribe a la misma universidad que Light.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Las sospechas de L se profundizan, Light lo persuade de invitarlo a la investigación, pero en ese momento una llamada de teléfono les avisa que ¡Soichiro Yagami ha sufrido un ataque al corazón!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Como se predijo en las cintas enviadas a Sakura TV, presentadores de noticias y comentaristas que expresaron dudas sobre Kira mueren uno por uno. Siguiendo las muertes, L concluye que existe un segundo Kira.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Es el primer partido de la fase final. Uruguay comienza con ataques ultrarrápidos, que logra un gol en apenas los primeros cincuenta segundos. Pero el alemán Schneider logra igualar el marcador. Nadie sabe qué delantero dominará el juego...

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: En el segundo partido de la final, Japón se enfrenta al anfitrión Francia en un estadio lleno de seguidores del equipo local. Japón ejecuta un ataque triple, recuperando el balón de un furioso capitán francés, Pierre, quien parece estar planeando algo...

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: A los diez minutos del primer tiempo, Soda recibe su segunda tarjeta amarilla, lo que obliga a Japón a continuar con sólo diez jugadores. Pierre recibe un penalty, dejando el marcador 2-1. Hyuga no se rinde, pero Japón parece no tener suerte...

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: En la segunda mitad, la lluvia azota a los jugadores y al campo. Francia intensifica su ataque, pero Japón logra resistir. Izawa queda gravemente herido y en su lugar emerge Misugi creando esperanza. ¡Es hora de que inicie la guerra entre capitanes!

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: ¡He aquí el enigmático Ataque Eiffel de Francia! El equipo de Japón está listo, pero Pierre y Napoleón van con todo. El trabajo de pase perfecto es prueba de la fuerza francesa en su camino hacia la portería. ¿Podrá Tsubasa reanimar al equipo?

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Gracias a Misaki, el marcador está empatado, dando inicio al primer tiempo extra del partido. El entrenador Mikami se ha quedado sin suplentes y todos están muy cansados. Ahora los peores temores de Japón se han hecho realidad. Las cosas no se ven bien…

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Es tiempo extra y Hyuga está preparado para luchar. Ahora enfrenta a Pierre, pero su pierna gravemente herida le impide mantener el control del balón. Francia continúa lanzando una feroz ola de ataques. Mientras tanto, Wakashimazu se retuerce de dolor.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Los tiempos extra y los saques de salida causan presión. El silbato suena. ¿Quién tendrá suerte hoy?

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Finalmente, la gran final. Japón se enfrentará a Alemania. Aunque el equipo japonés ha llegado lejos, hay varios jugadores lesionados. La gran sorpresa es la alineación inicial y el debut de Wakabayashi es ahora. ¡Japón emerge como el país más fuerte!

programme.title: PAW Patrol LT

programme.title: PAW Patrol LT

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: iCarly: La intervención
programme.desc: Carly debe hacer algo ya que Spencer se ha vuelto adicto a un video juego. Mientras tanto Sam engaña a Freddie haciéndole creer que por no seguir una cadena de correos electrónicos, le traerá una eterna mala suerte.

programme.title: iCarly: La Navidad
programme.desc: Con la intención de cambiar la tradición navideña Spencer consigue un árbol poco convencional, que accidentalmente prende fuego todos los regalos que Carly ha dejado en él. Enojadísima, ella pide el deseo de tener un hermano más normal.

programme.title: iCarly: El primer beso

programme.title: iCarly: Regalo un auto

programme.title: iCarly: Fred está muerto

programme.title: iCarly: Mmm... Me parezco

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Como se predijo en las cintas enviadas a Sakura TV, presentadores de noticias y comentaristas que expresaron dudas sobre Kira mueren uno por uno. Siguiendo las muertes, L concluye que existe un segundo Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Con un segundo Kira suelto, L le pide a Light que se una al grupo de trabajo y se haga pasar por el verdadero Kira para atrapar al imitador.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light viaja a Aoyama para descubrir la identidad de el segundo Kira antes de que L sospeche más, pero Misa Amane, la nueva Kira, usa su inusual don para encontrar a Light antes de que él la encuentre.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light y Misa muestran sus Death Notes, entonces Light le pide a Misa que use a su Shinigami Rem para que se deshaga de L, pero Misa le pide algo a cambio, ¡que se enamore de ella!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Hay evidencia que señala a Misa Amane como el segundo Kira, en un esfuerzo para salvarla, Rem obliga a Misa a renunciar como propietaria del Death Note.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Misa está en confinamiento a pesar de que sus recuerdos del Death Note han sido borrados. Cuando Light es encerrado también, los asesinatos se detienen y las sospechas hacia Light se vuelven más fuertes. De repente los asesinatos comienzan de nuevo.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Después de 50 días de reclusión, los asesinatos continúan, Misa y Light son liberados, pero L tiene un plan para garantizar que no se cometan más homicidios, por lo que el padre de Light, Soichiro, lleva a la pareja en un viaje que podría ser el último.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A pesar de que L aún sospecha, Light y Misa (sus recuerdos de haber sido Kira han sido borrados) regresan al cuartel donde Light se da cuenta de una extraña conección entre los recientes asesinatos de Kira y el Grupo Yotsuba.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Matsuda el elemento del cuerpo especial encargado de vigilar a Misa, está ansioso por sobresalir, mientras está en una misión con Misa, decide husmear por su cuenta en el cuartel del Grupo Yotsuba.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Finalmente, la gran final. Japón se enfrentará a Alemania. Aunque el equipo japonés ha llegado lejos, hay varios jugadores lesionados. La gran sorpresa es la alineación inicial y el debut de Wakabayashi es ahora. ¡Japón emerge como el país más fuerte!

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: ¡Ha llegado el momento del inicio de la final! La investigación de Wakabayashi sobre el equipo Aleman ha demostrado ser exitosa, ya que Japón está dominando el juego. Sólo que esta vez el portero de Alemania es el elusivo Gigante de Acero, Deuter Müller.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Japón está asombrado por la habilidad de Müller para bloquear todos los tiros. De repente, Muller realiza un pase largo hacia Schneider, frente a la portería japonesa. ¡La batalla entre Wakabayashi y Schneider inicia!

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: En la primera mitad, la investigación de Wakabayashi favorece a Japón. Japón obtiene otra oportunidad con un tiro libre para el primer punto, pero Müller extrañamente no quiere obstáculos entre él y Tsubasa en la portería.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: El Tiro de Fuego de Schneider puede haber acabado con las esperanzas de Japón de conseguir el primer punto, pero Hyuga está planeando una remontada. Con la ayuda de Tsubasa, se desencadena algo inesperado: ¡la patada más feroz en la historia del fútbol!

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Veinticinco minutos en la primera mitad, Tsubasa y Misaki combinan fuerzas para igualar el juego. Ahora, Schneider está aún más motivado y se enfrenta directamente a Wakabayashi. Schneider audazmente desata su Tiro de Fuego. Las chispas vuelan.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Algo ha estado preocupando a Tsubasa. El enigmático mensaje de Katagiri en el entretiempo sobre la página 52 debe hacer referencia al cuaderno, aquel en el que Roberto plasmó todo lo que sabía. Tsubasa revive recuerdos y las lecciones del pasado.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: ¡Japón anota un segundo punto y Alemania está frenética! Schneider no siente su pierna izquierda. Justo cuando parece que la ofensiva Alemana ha cedido bajo presión, Schneider reanima a sus compañeros. El "Obrero de Alemania", Kaltz, está emocionado.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Schneider empata el marcador con solo siete minutos restantes. Ahora es una guerra total. Tsubasa intenta avanzar con el balón, pero Kaltz lo derriba brutalmente en el aire, haciendo que Tsubasa caiga al suelo. ¡El torneo termina ahora!

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Los maridos están siendo atraídos fuera de su pueblo por un hermoso demonio. Sus esposas le piden a Miroku que derrote al demonio. Preocupado por él, Sango lo acompaña. Pero Sango está separado de él por una extraña niebla.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
programme.desc: Sango regresa a la aldea de los asesinos para arreglar su Hiraikotsu, y Kagome regresa al pozo para que pueda regresar al día presente. En el camino, encuentra una Nimenka, una fruta que parece una cara.

programme.title: Inuyasha LT

programme.title: Inuyasha LT

programme.title: Inuyasha LT
